{{Top|leg}}
'''Avabush''' was a prickly [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could be used to produce [[Avabush spice]]. Avabush was the most common form of vegetation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baros]], and was a eaten by [[Brubb]]s.
